summary: Full backend + frontend regression of MejoraTuWeb (no emergentintegrations, OpenAI fallback heuristic). 9/9 pytest cases pass against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend Landing flow works end-to-end: empty URL shows error, quick-scan renders QuickScanCard with score+checks+HTTPS badge+response_time, fallback analysis renders pain message with errors/money_lost, and all three Stripe CTAs (unlock-btn, premium-btn pattern, floating-unlock-btn) point to https://buy.stripe.com/28E7sMbKhelIeUN8Tq63K00.
critical_code_review_comments: FloatingCTA.js line 18 reads `document.querySelector(...)` at render (outside useEffect) - works because the variable is unused, but the dead-code call should be removed.
server.py /api/analyze re-invokes quick_scan() and then re-fetches the HTML when OPENAI_API_KEY is set, performing two HTTP requests to the target. Consider caching the html from the first fetch.
save_document() serialises payloads twice (json.dumps then insert_one) - fine functionally but wasteful for large analyses.
OPENAI_API_KEY not configured in this env - only the heuristic fallback path was exercised; the live OpenAI branch was not validated.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 critical flows: load, empty-URL error, quick-scan render, results render, Stripe CTA targets)

seed_data_creation: None. Used https://example.com for live scans and TEST_user@example.com for email subscribe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL is in /app/frontend/.env. Backend served at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + /api. Run regression with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_mejoratuweb.py`. OpenAI key is intentionally absent so /api/analyze returns the heuristic fallback - if you add a key, the live AI branch needs separate coverage. CORS test only checks OPTIONS for two allowed origins; add more if regression scope grows.
rca of the issue: N/A - no defects found this iteration. emergentintegrations confirmed absent in requirements.txt and source. CORS includes https://mejoratuweb.org and https://mejoratuweb.onrender.com explicitly.
